text.text: Armor for a wolf, built from Tinkers materials. The plating decides armour and toughness, the lining carries the material traits, and the binding holds it together.
Right-click a wolf with the armor to put it on (works on wild wolves too, like horse armor); sneak-right-click with an empty hand to take it off.

properties: Armour value and durability come from the plating material
Fits a wolf, not a player
